check_trf013_violations: check a Python AST tree for TRF013 violations where __init__ of PreTrainedModel subclasses does not call self.post_init()
test_post_init_call: test that a PreTrainedModel subclass __init__ properly calls self.post_init()
refactor_missing_post_init: refactor a PreTrainedModel __init__ to add a call to self.post_init()
review_pretrained_model_init: review a PreTrainedModel subclass __init__ to verify self.post_init() is called
summarize_trf013_rule: summarize the TRF013 lint rule that requires __init__ of PreTrainedModel subclasses to call self.post_init()
